Property Properly are delighted to present to the market No. 29 Droimnín Stradbally, Co. Laois a beautifully maintained home..

Welcome to No. 29 Droimnín, a superbly presented property set within a quiet, friendly, and well-established community designed for comfort and ease of living.

Extending to approximately 804 sq. ft., this charming home offers a thoughtfully designed layout, ideal for those seeking a peaceful, low-maintenance lifestyle in a secure and welcoming environment.

The accommodation comprises a bright and spacious living room, filled with natural light, perfect for relaxing or entertaining family and friends. The generous eat-in kitchen provides ample room for everyday living, combining practicality with comfort.

There are two well-proportioned bedrooms, including a spacious primary bedroom, offering flexibility for guests, hobbies, or additional storage. The bathroom is finished as a modern wet room, ensuring accessibility and ease of use. A well-laid-out hallway enhances the flow and convenience throughout the home.

A standout feature of the property is the screened porch, providing a sheltered outdoor space to enjoy fresh air all year round  ideal for morning coffee, reading, or simply unwinding in a peaceful setting.

Additional features include a pellet stove for efficient heating, a dedicated parking space, and an electric vehicle charging port, adding modern convenience to this charming home.

 Lifestyle & Location

Droimnín is renowned for its quiet, safe, and community-focused atmosphere, making it an ideal choice for those looking to enjoy a relaxed pace of life while remaining well connected.

Located in the heart of Stradbally, the property is within easy reach of local shops, cafés, pharmacy services, and everyday amenities. The village also benefits from good transport links, offering convenient access to Portlaoise and surrounding areas.

Whether enjoying a gentle walk, meeting neighbours, or simply relaxing at home, this location offers the perfect balance. This freehold Property with ample
